annotations.title: Earnings season: beats, misses and surprises

description: How the S&P 500's reporting season is going, no key: how many of its companies have reported, the share that beat, matched or missed the consensus EPS estimate and the median surprise (Nasdaq's calendar, Zacks' consensus), how the ten largest did, the largest beats and misses, by_sector for the eleven sectors, and who is due in the coming days; symbols gives named companies' results first. Members are SPY's daily holdings; share classes count once.

by_sector.description: The same for each of the S&P 500's eleven sectors (reads the Select Sector SPDRs' holdings too).

limit.description: Largest beats and misses listed, each; default 5.

list.description: Reports listed, largest companies first; default 30.

since.description: The first report date counted; default the day after the last calendar quarter ended.

symbols.description: List these companies' results (and whether each is still due) instead of the largest; the season's tally still covers every member.

until.description: The last report date counted; default today. At most 70 days after since.

name: earnings_season

outputSchema.description: rows are the companies that reported, largest first, in the order of columns; tally counts beats, matches and misses.

title: Earnings season: beats, misses and surprises
